data.title: JCR Affirms İşbir Sentetik’s BBB (tr) National Corporate Rating
data.description:
Isbir Sentetik Dokuma Sanayi AS ( (TR:ISSEN) ) has shared an announcement.

JCR Avrasya assessed İşbir Sentetik Dokuma Sanayi and affirmed its Long-Term National Corporate Credit Rating at BBB (tr), with a Stable outlook. Its Short-Term National rating was J2 (tr)/Stable, while both long-term international foreign- and local-currency ratings were BB/Stable.

The assessment cited stable revenue generation in 2025 and maintained sales performance in the first nine months of 2026, alongside an adequate equity-to-total-assets ratio, strong interest coverage, some natural hedging from foreign-currency-weighted sales, diversified customers, and mostly secured and insured receivables. It also noted 2025 deterioration in leverage and cash-flow metrics, weaker profitability margins, and efficiency pressure from the business’s long cash-conversion cycle.

data.title: Edgemont Updates Laiva Transaction and CSE Listing Review
data.description:
Edgemont Gold Corp. ( (TSE:EDGM) ) has shared an update.

The release concerns Edgemont Gold Corp.’s transaction with Laiva Gold Inc., whose activities include exploration and related studies at the Laiva Gold Project in Finland. Laiva is conducting environmental, engineering and feasibility studies related to resource expansion, environmental compliance and optimization of mining and milling methods.

Edgemont submitted a draft amended and restated listing statement to the CSE, which remains subject to review and comment. Laiva also reported a $1 million non-interest-bearing promissory note, conversion of $2.39 million in convertible debentures, a September private placement raising $3,318,426, and an initial US$5 million advance under a bridge facility allowing borrowing of up to US$15 million.

Approximately 15,000 metres of drilling have been completed at the Laiva project, while the Finnish Supreme Administrative Court’s decision on leave to appeal regarding the mine’s environmental permit remains pending. Inspection reports continue to confirm that there are no physical deficiencies at the mine site.

data.title: EMAS Shareholders Approve Plan for Up to 10% Capital Increase
data.description:
PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk ( (ID:EMAS) ) has shared an announcement.

PT Merdeka Gold Resources Tbk’s shareholders approved a plan to conduct NPR I, a capital increase with pre-emptive rights, involving up to 1,473,136,606 shares, or a maximum of 10% of the company’s issued and fully paid-up shares. The approval was granted at a GMS attended by shareholders representing 58.15% of valid voting shares, with implementation subject to applicable regulatory requirements and possible issuance in one or more tranches.

The plan also provides for an amendment to Article 4 paragraph (2) of the company’s Articles of Association. The release lists the current board composition, with the directors and commissioners’ terms ending on 30 June 2029, including four independent commissioners.

data.title: Western Metallica Extends Exclusivity for Nueva Celti Copper Project
data.description:
An announcement from Western Metallica Resources Corp. ( (TSE:WMS) ) is now available.

Western Metallica said the exclusivity period under its agreement with AJAX Resources for the Nueva Celti Copper Project in Andalusia, Spain, has been extended to December 18, 2026. The agreement gives AJAX an exclusive and irrevocable option to acquire 100% of Western Metallica’s Spanish subsidiary that owns the project.

Subject to conditions precedent, revised consideration for the proposed acquisition is US$145,000; if those conditions are not met, previously announced terms will prevail. TSXV conditional approval has been received, with closing still subject to conditions including shareholder approval.
